name: Keyoxide---Web
description: Keyoxide is a privacy-friendly tool to create and verify decentralized online identities. This is the web interface. It is recommended to also run a Keyoxide - Proxy container alongside it.

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: The domain on which the instance is hosted

variables.name: Onion URL
variables.description: The onion URL that points to the same instance

variables.name: Proxy Hostname
variables.description: The hostname and port of the Keyoxide Proxy instance (e.g., IP_ADDRESS:3001)

variables.name: ActivityPub Public Key
variables.description: The public key used to simulate an ActivityPub account and sign HTTP requests

variables.name: Experimental - Enable Cache
variables.description: Enable the experimental caching mechanism to improve performance

variables.name: Experimental - Enable Rate Limiter
variables.description: Enable the experimental rate limiting feature to prevent abuse

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: The internal port the web interface listens on. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Act as Proxy
variables.description: Disable proxy functionality. Not recommended to change.
